remarks: The sale of this home is subjected to probate court approval. The property is being sold in as is condition and with all the contents remaining. You are within a few minutes drive to everything including 1.2 miles to all major shopping, Starbucks, D & D & restaurants, 1.75 miles to the park, 4.4 miles to the Merritt Parkway, 1.5 miles to I-95 north & south ramps, 2.2 miles to Westport train station
